baseline_pre_retrain_status.rationale: Neither training/retrain_report.md nor training/forensic_report.md documents the training start date, end date, or sample range for baseline_pre_retrain. Per pre-registered instructions, its training range cannot be established and it is therefore not evaluated.

leakages.description: add_tbm_target and add_target look ahead H=12 bars into the future (t+1..t+12). If the split boundary is at index S, labels for candles S-11..S-1 peek into the validation partition. Purging H bars at the boundary is strictly required.
leakages.mitigation: Purge at least H bars (plus 24h embargo) at all split boundaries.

leakages.category: StandardScaler Lookahead via Full Dataset Fit
leakages.description: fit_and_save_scalers(df) fits StandardScaler across all rows in df. If invoked before train/validation/test splitting, out-of-sample mean and variance leak into training scale factors.
leakages.mitigation: Fit scalers strictly on training partition (df_train) only.

leakages.description: compute_hmm_regimes and compute_garch_volatility use rolling windows but refit every 50 or 100 bars. In legacy code, if computed across the unbroken concatenated dataset, regime boundaries can bridge evaluation cutoffs unless strictly isolated.
leakages.mitigation: Causal feature generation with strict cutoff t <= decision_time - 5m.

leakages.category: Indicator Warmup Pre-roll and Missing Data Filling
leakages.description: Long-lookback indicators (e.g. fib_618_dist_180d with 720 bars = 30 days) require 720 bars of pre-roll warmup. Using bfill() or premature fillna(0.0) would leak future values backward into initial observations.
leakages.mitigation: Exclude pre-roll observations from training/test sample sets.

power_analysis.rationale: With N=2032 hourly bars (84.7 days) and 12-bar holding periods (effective N ~ 169), the minimum detectable IC at 80% power is 0.214. Financial alpha in liquid crypto perps is rarely above 0.03-0.05. A sample size of at least 10,000 independent bars (>1.5 years) is required to reliably detect realistic edge. The current 85-day OOS period is severely statistically underpowered.
